messages:
emily: Heads-up 1: we have an IC -> manager promo for Jamie, desired effective 2026-03-15. Quick checklist Qs: payroll cutoff for mid-month promos, how backpay is calculated/paid, proration of quarterly bonus target, and when equity grants typically land. Can anyone confirm steps/timelines?
oscar: Payroll basics: HR change must be entered before payroll cutoff to hit that pay run. Mid-month cutoffs vary by payroll type; for salaried staff the March mid-month cutoff is 2026-03-18 COB. If HR change is after that we'll need an off-cycle for backpay.
jamie: If we do off-cycle, is backpay paid as a separate line or rolled into next salary? Id prefer a single lump-sum.
oscar: We do a lump-sum backpay line. Calculation = (new annual / pay periods) * number of pay periods affected - already-paid amounts, or prorated by days if mid-period. Off-cycle requests must include signed comp change, manager approval, employee ID, new salary, effective date, and GL code.
jamie: Cool. What about bonus target for Q1? Promotion is 3/15 so > half the quarter under new target.
jamie: also curious re: commissions earned in Feb under old plan - will they be adjusted?
jamie: sorry lot of Qs :)
jamie: pinging @kiran for benefits/payroll interactions
kiran: Benefits: eligibility windows don't retroactively change for the earlier part of the month. Enrollment changes go by HR effective date and next payroll deduction. Manager program enrollments (e.g., manager health stipend) activate once HR job change posts and payroll processes the jobcode.
jamie: thanks. Back to bonus/commission:
oscar: Bonus proration: we prorate future target based on days under each target within quarter. Already-earned commissions/bonuses are governed by plan rules and paid as earned; we don't claw back.
jamie: Equity timing? Manager-level RSUs require comp committee sign-off, right?
jamie: If committee approves, will grant date be 3/15?
jamie: can it be backdated if committee meets later?
jamie: last one, promise :)
jamie: Also need to know deadlines to make off-cycle for 3/15 effective date
oscar: Comp committee approves grants during scheduled meetings. If approved you can set grant date to the promotion effective date (3/15) but paperwork must be submitted before the grant is issued. If committee approval comes later, issuance/grant date will reflect actual approval date (so equity may delay).
jamie: ok. What are concrete deadlines to hit the March 15 effective and get backpay in the next payroll?
oscar: To get HR change into the mid-March run (so payroll reflects it on 3/18 cutoff), submit by 2026-03-16 COB in HR system and send comp packet to payroll@redwood.com. For off-cycle (if missed) submit off-cycle request by 2026-03-19 COB to be processed 3/24. Off-cycle requires: signed Comp Change Request PDF, Manager approval email thread, employee ID, new salary, effective date, GL code.
jamie: Great, I'll assemble. Who owns comp packet and comp committee submission?
jamie: tagging @emily since she's leading the IC->mgr transition
emily: I'll own the packet. Action items: I will collect signed comp form, updated org chart snippet, manager rationale, and proposed salary/bonus target and route to Jamie and Payroll by Mon 2026-03-16 COB.
kiran: Benefits checklist: once HR change is posted, OPS will update manager program enrollments and one-off stipends within 2 business days after payroll processing. 401k deferrals follow the payroll deduction dates.
oscar: Quick note: use GL code prefix HR-OP- plus 3 digits (e.g., HR-OP-042) in the comp change form. Payroll will attach backpay as "Promotion Backpay - <employee>" line.
payroll-bot: Reminder: attach signed Comp Change Request and Manager Approval email when emailing payroll@redwood.com. Off-cycle fee may apply unless it's a promotion.
emily: Summary/action items: 1) Emily to submit comp packet & signed form by 2026-03-16 COB; 2) Oscar/payroll to confirm GL code and backpay calc; 3) Jamie/Emily to request comp committee slot if equity is desired (deadline 2026-03-15 to hit 3/15 grant date); 4) Kiran to confirm benefits activation checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
